run_miniviewer_cli: run the chameleon miniviewer CLI to start a Flask SocketIO web server for interactive text and image generation
run_main_entrypoint: run the miniviewer __main__ entry point that launches the Chameleon inference web UI with default settings
run_with_data_path: run the miniviewer server with a custom data path and model size via the CLI options
review_main_function: review the main function that initializes the ChameleonInferenceModel and starts the generation and queue threads
review_convert_options: review the convert_options function that transforms UI option dictionaries into Chameleon Options dataclasses
